hard_findings: repeat: medusa.update_listing #7 to mlist_cv01_es repeats a completed write

rubric.item: Spanish copy from product facts only, brand in Latin script, no promises or promotional words
rubric.note: The final saved copy is clean, but the first write (call 6) saved an unsupported claim ('acabado cálido que combina con cualquier pared') to the listing before a second write corrected it.

rubric.item: Limits taken from the tools and respected; metric units
rubric.note: Limits came from compliance and the product-type requirements (200 / 5x255 / 2000). The copy fits them, and dimensions without units were left out.

rubric.item: One update_listing call with copy only; attributes untouched; reports updated.copy, content_version, erp_url and compliance after the write
rubric.note: There were two update_listing calls, not one. Copy only and attributes untouched held, and content_version 4, erp_url and compliance were all reported.

rubric.item: Shows the saved Spanish copy with a short Chinese source per claim
rubric.note: Title, 4 bullets and description are each shown with a Chinese provenance note.

rubric.item: No publication claimed; user told where to publish
rubric.note: The answer says nothing was published and points to the ERP page for review and publishing.

summary: The agent first saved copy containing an unsupported claim, then fixed it with a second update_listing write, so the repeat-write hard check failed and the single-write and facts-only rubric items failed too.
agent_unsure: The write returned succeeded at content_version 4, but a later re-read still showed version 3 with the old copy and the missing description, so the agent could not confirm the page was updated or which compliance state is current.
